operating_notes.text: Sold 239,646 units in April 2026, achieving highest-ever monthly sales.
Total production for April 2026 stood at 209,565 units, up 16.5% YoY.
Commenced commercial production at the second Kharkhoda plant with a capacity of 250,000 units, bringing total annual capacity to 2.65 million units.
Announced price increase of up to ₹30,000 across models effective June 2026 due to input cost pressures.
Maruti Suzuki registered highest-ever monthly sales volume of 242,688 units in May 2026.
Total production for May 2026 stood at 230,041 units, up 17.4% YoY.
Launched India's first flex-fuel car (Wagon R) compatible with E20 to E100 ethanol blends.
The flex-fuel Wagon R is homologated with E85 fuel as per CMVR GSR 27(E).

ITAT order for eight years (F.Y. 2013-14 to F.Y. 2019-20 and F.Y. 2021-22) largely in the company's favour, with a positive tax impact including interest of about ₹13,000 Cr and a contingent-liability reduction of about ₹6,300 Cr, primarily
Board approved incorporation of OSCOE Foundation as a Section 8 not-for-profit subsidiary for CSR and vocational training.
Board approved incorporation of a Section 8 company for setting up the Osamu Suzuki Centre of Excellence.
Q2FY27: EBITDA margin fell 330 bps YoY due to adverse commodity prices and forex movement.
Q2FY27: Non-operating income fell 160 bps YoY due to mark-to-market losses on invested surplus.
Q2FY27: Domestic sales grew 33.6% YoY, while exports declined 2.1% YoY.
Cumulative EV exports crossed 50,000 units since global shipments began in August 2025, accounting for ~93% of India's passenger vehicle EV exports in April-September 2026.
Hansalpur facility in Gujarat expanded to an annual production capacity of 1 million vehicles, backed by ₹25,288.7 Cr cumulative investment.
October 2026: Achieved highest-ever monthly sales volume of 276,120 units.
October 2026: Domestic sales reached an all-time high of 216,789 units.
October 2026 production: 260,003 units total, of which passenger cars 122,243, utility vehicles 119,253, vans 14,278 and LCV Super Carry 4,229.

timeline.summary: Maruti Suzuki updated that company arguments before the CCI concluded, with the next hearing scheduled for May 11, 2026.
Maruti Suzuki reported standalone FY26 revenue of ₹183,266.1 Cr and PAT of ₹14,445.4 Cr, recommending a dividend of ₹140 per share.
Maruti Suzuki reported its highest-ever monthly sales of 239,646 units in April 2026.
Maruti Suzuki reported in total production to 209,565 units for April 2026.
Maruti Suzuki filed the transcript of its Q4FY26 earnings call on May 4, 2026.
Maruti Suzuki updated that the CCI matter was adjourned to May 25, 2026 for arguments.
On May 18, 2026, Maruti Suzuki commenced commercial production at its second plant in Kharkhoda, expanding total capacity to 2.65 million units.
Maruti Suzuki announced a price increase of up to ₹30,000 across its model portfolio effective June 2026 due to rising input costs.
Maruti Suzuki announced a recall of 26 Super Carry vehicles on May 22, 2026, due to a possible defect in the front driver seat adjuster assembly.
Maruti Suzuki updated that the CCI matter was further adjourned to May 27, 2026 for arguments.
On June 1, 2026; Maruti Suzuki reported total sales of 242,688 units for May 2026
Maruti Suzuki reported total production of 230,041 units for May 2026
Maruti Suzuki launched India's first flex-fuel car, a Wagon R compatible with E20 to E100 ethanol blends, on June 4, 2026.
Maruti Suzuki received a favourable ITAT order yielding a positive tax impact of ~₹1,300 Cr and reducing contingent liabilities by ~₹6,300 Cr.
Maruti Suzuki India Limited launched the VICTORIS AURUM Edition Strong Hybrid on 24 October 2026 with a kit price of INR 22,990.
On October 27, 2026, Maruti Suzuki's board approved the incorporation of Osamu Suzuki Centre of Excellence (OSCOE) Foundation as a wholly owned Section 8 subsidiary for CSR activities.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹53,355.5 Cr, net profit ₹2,466.1 Cr (includes ₹69 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹2,397.1 Cr).
Maruti Suzuki reported Q2FY27 net sales of ₹50,615.5 Cr and net profit of ₹2,414.9 Cr alongside record quarterly sales volumes.
Maruti Suzuki India Limited reported Q2FY27 standalone results with sales up 26.1% YoY but PAT down 26.9% YoY due to margin pressure.
Maruti Suzuki announced crossing 50,000 cumulative EV exports from its Hansalpur facility, capturing ~93% of India's PV EV exports in H1FY27.
Maruti Suzuki reported its highest-ever monthly sales of 276,120 units in October 2026.
Maruti Suzuki reported October 2026 production of 260,003 units; with utility vehicles at 119,253 units.
